headlines.title: Exelon Seeks to Protect Customers from "Unreasonable Costs" in New FERC Complaint
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON, November 04, 2026--Exelon today filed a complaint with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) challenging PJM Interconnection LLC’s current capacity auction schedule. The complaint calls for a targeted reform aimed at protecting customers from unreasonable costs while regional stakeholders continue to chart a path forward on holistic market reforms.

headlines.title: I Bonds Now Pay 5.51%. Can Dividend Stocks Compete?
headlines.summary: The Treasury is paying more than any stock in this month's income basket, but the comparison gets complicated fast once you factor in taxes, timing, and what happens the moment inflation cools.

headlines.title: Exelon Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
headlines.summary: As Exelon has underperformed relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a cautious outlook about the stock’s prospects.

headlines.title: Exelon eyes $8B in energy storage, in part to address PJM supply crunch
headlines.summary: President and CEO Calvin Butler said the grid operator isn’t adding generation fast enough, but the utility’s plan to invest in energy storage and transmission can help address the issue.

headlines.title: Exelon (EXC) Stock Shrugs Off Q3 Earnings As Regulatory Risks Linger
headlines.summary: Exelon stock barely budged after its Q3 2026 report, ticking up about 0.5% to US$46.16, yet the headline result was far from sleepy. The utility delivered adjusted operating earnings of US$0.87 per share and tightened full year guidance to US$2.85 to US$2.91, which puts real numbers behind the story the price is only hinting at. Short term traders see a quiet chart. Long term holders see a regulated utility lining up a US$41.

description: Exelon Corporation, a utility services holding company, engages in the energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. The company is involved in the purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas; transmission and distribution of electricity; and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. It serves residential, commercial, industrial, and public authorities and electric railroads customers. Exelon Corporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.
